checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so the disclosure is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The basic services includesText names an arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits and authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
The list shows only the basic services fee as overhead; no other mandatory facilities, handling, or staff fee text appears.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the embalming price is on page 1, so they are on the same page.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket funeral without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, so they are on the same page.
The direct cremation options include purchaser-provided container and alternative containers; no text says a casket is required.
The direct cremation includesText lists transportation and cremation but no separate crematory cash-advance charge is shown, so there is no double-billing.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no other offered good or service appears only inside a description.
The list contains no optional combination package; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery, or a crematory requires a purchase beyond the wording of the required disclosures.
No text claims preservation, long-term prevention of decomposition, or protection from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts the required disclosures, and the required disclosures use the prescribed wording.
